data.name: Dataset based on UWB for Clinical Establishments
data.abstract: The authors come forth with a data set acquired from an intelligent surveillance system based on the bleeding edge technology – Ultra wide band technology. The intelligent surveillance system is proposed to prefect the movement of patients in and out of hospitals and other clinical establishments. The raw data is amassed from UWB anchors and tags affixed in the clinical arena using a wearable tag. The chronophagous behaviour of following up on the records of patients with respect to their arrival and departure manually is abhorred using the proposed surveillance system. The data described in the manuscript is a result of the system implemented in an area of 12.5m X 16.5m inside a hospital premises.

intro_paper.title: A UWB System Model for Patient Tracking and Monitoring for Smart Healthcare
intro_paper.authors: Shilpa Shyam; Sujitha Juliet; Kirubakaran Ezra
intro_paper.journal: 2022 6th International Conference on Devices, Circuits and Systems (ICDCS)

additional_info.purpose: The dataset was created from a novel surveillance and monitoring system using Ultra wide band technology implemented in a clinical estabilishment. UWB datasets implemented in hospitals are barely found and hence this dataset would be useful. The dataset deals with timing pulses procured from wearable worn by patients inside the hospital to identify their movement through out their stay.
